title: Run 22's prediction tested: the +11% lives in the fit, and it ignites the deadband
question: Where does the pipeline's +10.8% gain excess live, and does an 11% bump really ignite the backlash limit cycle?
headline: The excess is the numerical FIT (x1.116 uniform; the Q12 quantisation is clean at x0.995) — fixed by pinning the fitted equilibrium Jacobian to the law. And the bifurcation is real: gain x1.11 in the fixed sim gives sigma 1.85x (matching hardware's 1.85x) with duty p90 exploding 17.5% -> 77.3% while the median barely moves.
